name: Tabstack
tagline: Browsing infrastructure for AI agents — extract, research, automate.
description: A managed web API that lets agents browse the live web without running headless Chrome. /extract turns pages into Markdown or structured JSON, /generate transforms content on the fly, and /automate clicks, scrolls, and fills forms. Lightweight fetches escalate to full browser automation only when a site needs JS execution.
insight: Built by Mozilla; its execution engine, Pilo, is open-sourced under Apache-2.0 as the OSS core beneath the hosted API.

modelSupport.notes: Infrastructure layer — returns LLM-ready web data to any agent or model.

edge: Mozilla-backed and escalates from cheap fetch to full automation only when a page demands it — paying for a browser only when you need one.
pros: Single API for extract, generate, and automate
Markdown/JSON output tuned for LLM context
cons: Hosted service is proprietary (only the engine is OSS)
Credit-based pricing can be hard to forecast
Newer entrant vs. established browser-infra players

references.title: Show HN: Tabstack – Browser infrastructure for AI agents (by Mozilla)
